0022600222.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (9-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West, on a five-game winning streak) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 15th in the East, on a six-game losing streak), who are 5.5 games back in the Central. The Lakers will be without Austin Reaves, who is out with an illness and is averaging 25.3 points and 36.2 minutes this season, and Quentin Grimes, who is out with a finger injury and is averaging 8.0 points this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 9, 2026, in Los Angeles, where the Lakers lost 105-101.
